# Kristu Jayanti Journal

> > Kristu Jayanti University's comprehensive platform for peer-reviewed academic publishing across management sciences, biology, humanities, computational sciences, and regional language scholarship.

The Kristu Jayanti Journal platform hosts seven peer-reviewed academic journals published by Kristu Jayanti University in Bengaluru, serving diverse research communities across STEM, social sciences, and regional language scholarship. Each journal maintains rigorous academic standards with DOI registration and open-access publishing models.

## Core Journals

- [Kristu Jayanti Journal of Management Sciences (KJMS)](https://kristujayantijournal.com/index.php/ijcm): Peer-reviewed journal publishing management sciences and business research articles from Kristu Jayanti University.
- [Kristu Jayanti Journal of Computational Sciences (KJCS)](https://kristujayantijournal.com/index.php/ijcs): Peer-reviewed journal publishing machine learning, AI, and computational research articles.
- [Kristu Jayanti Journal of Core and Applied Biology (KJCAB)](https://kristujayantijournal.com/index.php/ijls): Open-access journal for peer-reviewed biology and life sciences research.
- [Kristu Jayanti Journal of Humanities and Social Sciences (KJHSS)](https://kristujayantijournal.com/index.php/ijss): Multidisciplinary peer-reviewed journal for humanities and social sciences research.

## Regional Language Journals

- [Kristu Jayanti Kannada Samshodhana Pathrike](https://kristujayantijournal.com/index.php/KJKSP): Kannada-language peer-reviewed research journal for Kannada literature and cultural studies.
- [ANEKANT: Kristu Jayanti Hindi Shodh Patrika](https://kristujayantijournal.com/index.php/akjhsp): Hindi-language scholarly journal for Hindi literature, criticism, and humanities research.

## Portal & Overview

- [Kristu Jayanti College Journals](https://www.kristujayantijournal.com): Homepage showcasing Kristu Jayanti University's four peer-reviewed academic journals across disciplines.
